morphology.pattern_note: 单纯词，无马来语词缀变化。输入包的 wé.las 标示两音节及 e taling；syllables 字段按原始值保留 null。不要把词首 w 当作可替换的词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 怜悯、同情或慈悲之情，尤指对他人的困苦产生关怀；常见于固定词组 welas asih。
senses.en_definition: Compassion or pity, especially sympathetic concern for another person's suffering; also used in the expression welas asih.
senses.ms_definition: Jw belas, kasihan; welas asih: belas kasihan.
senses.nuances: Kamus Dewan 标记 Jw，说明其爪哇语来源；被词典收录不表示它是马来西亚日常交流中的常用首选词。一般表达可用 belas kasihan。这里按情感名词用法标注词性，并非声称原始释义提供了词性标签。词义见 [PRPM：belas kasihan 相关词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=belas+kasihan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公益机构发言 / 关怀主题文章
dual_scenarios.ms: Rasa welas asih perlu disertai tindakan yang menghormati maruah penerima bantuan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 慈悲之心应落实为尊重受助者尊严的行动。
dual_scenarios.en: Compassion should be accompanied by action that respects the dignity of those receiving assistance.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论阅读中遇到的词
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku baru baca frasa welas asih ni. Maksudnya belas kasihan je ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya baru membaca frasa 'welas asih' ini. Adakah maksudnya sama dengan belas kasihan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚读到 welas asih 这个说法，就是怜悯、同情的意思吗？
dual_scenarios.en: I've just come across 'welas asih'. Does it mean compassion?
spoken_features: 以阅读讨论呈现这个带来源标记的词

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku baru baca frasa welas asih ni. Maksudnya belas kasihan je ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya baru membaca frasa 'welas asih' ini. Adakah maksudnya sama dengan belas kasihan?
messages.zh: 我刚读到 welas asih 这个说法，就是怜悯、同情的意思吗？
messages.en: I've just come across 'welas asih'. Does it mean compassion?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, lebih kurang. Kalau nak cakap biasa, guna belas kasihan je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, maksudnya hampir sama. Dalam percakapan biasa, gunakan frasa 'belas kasihan' sahaja.
messages.zh: 对，差不多。平时说话用 belas kasihan 就行。
messages.en: Yes, pretty much. In everyday conversation, just say 'belas kasihan'.

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks welas as Javanese in origin and explains it through belas and kasihan. Its recorded expression welas asih brings compassion and affection together. The Javanese dictionary likewise records this emotional vocabulary. These records support the language connection, although they do not establish when or through which community the word entered Malay. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=belas+kasihan), [Javanese dictionary](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/welas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: welas 与 belas 读起来相近：看到 welas asih，就想到 belas kasihan，再想到“慈悲关怀”；这是记忆联想。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论受助者时，应强调关怀、尊重与实际支持，避免用怜悯语气暗示对方低人一等。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合关怀主题、文学表达及爪哇文化相关语境；面向广泛读者时可附上 belas kasihan，帮助理解。它不是恋爱关系的专门用语。
